sup:70110.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company with high-quality castings from our region, and we value our long standing relationship very much.

Our team has prepared our offer carefully. We can offer you a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

To remain transparent about our situation, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. We trust that you understand the necessity of these figures for our ongoing operation and quality standards.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.subject: HN 50-200 volute casings – counterproposal to your price adjustment
move.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

Thank you for your offer and the transparent cost information. Your own figures give a weighted increase of about 2.4 %: LCI-C +2.7 % on 30 % of cost and PPI-C241 +6.5 % on 24 % of cost. That is far below 9.5 %. Our contract ctr:4600070110 runs until 2026-12-31, so a change before 2027-01-01 is not possible for us. Your scorecard sc:70110@2026Q3 shows an on-time delivery rate of 85.2 %, which we need to see improve. We value a healthy partnership and propose the packages below. Could you share a cost breakdown for the casing?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. We respect our long-standing partnership and agree to align the effective date with your contract, starting 2027-01-01.

Although the indices you calculated account for a portion of our expenses, other operational costs require us to propose €136.50 for 30-day payment terms. Our costs move with LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351; the figures stay with us.

For our offer, we quote a price of €136.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 January 2027. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.subject: Re: HN 50-200 volute casings – counterproposal to your price adjustment
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Your letter gives 51 days' notice (doc:20260911-70110-P01), while our framework agreement requires 90 days (ctr:4600070110#3.1).
Our bottom-up cost model puts the full cost of this part at EUR 132.64 per unit (cost:310010).
Producer prices DE: electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -6.1% from 2025-11 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-11, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).

Please find our proposal below.
If faster payment helps you, we are open to it, as shown in the packages.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Since there are no new facts that alter our operational costs, we must maintain our offer of €136.60 per unit for 14-day payment terms starting 1 April 2027. We value our long-standing partnership and ask that you accept this carefully calculated price.

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. In recognition of this higher volume, we are prepared to adjust our offer to €134.80 per unit. 

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €134.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value our long-standing partnership and ask that you accept this carefully calculated price. At our foundry, we take great pride in our craft and our shared history with you. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Thank you for confirming the binding volume of 8,150 pieces per year over 12 months. In return for this firm commitment, we are pleased to adjust our offer to €133.60 per unit. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Under our Angebot, we are pleased to offer a price of €133.60 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days.

We have made a substantial step to meet you, and we ask that you accept this fair price to conclude our negotiations. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
